title: Reference Hash / Event ID (v3+)
notes: event_id = $ + unpadded base64 of SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the REDACTED event (signatures/unsigned removed, hashes retained). Base64 alphabet is a room-version attribute: STANDARD for v3, URL-safe for v4+ (hash_base64_engine). reference_hash(value, room_version) applies redact_json first; LeanEvent::from_value(value, Some(room_version)) derives a missing event_id. Invariant: event_id(e) == event_id(redact(e)).

title: Content Hash (hashes.sha256)
notes: compute_content_hash / verify_content_hash run at the PDU boundary on the raw unredacted serde_json::Value: strip unsigned/signatures/hashes, canonical JSON, SHA-256, base64 via the same room-version alphabet (STANDARD v3, URL-safe v4+). Not verifiable on the lean model (content is dropped).
